sequence.description: Protein sequence (single letters, A-Z) to run ESM3 against. The model emits per-residue embeddings and (when requested) a predicted backbone structure.

candidates.$comment: Canonical Candidate v1 input accepted additively; see src/vibeproteinagent/schemas/candidate_v1.json.
candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream tool. Promotes the first item's `sequence` into the `sequence` input when omitted.

model_name.description: ESM3 checkpoint identifier. `esm3_sm_open_v1` is the openly released 1.4B-parameter model; larger gated variants require a HuggingFace token configured outside this schema.

tracks.description: Output tracks to compute. `sequence` returns token logits, `structure` predicts a backbone (PDB output), `embedding` returns per-residue model representations.

num_steps.description: Number of iterative generation/sampling steps when ESM3 fills masked positions or generates structure. Larger values give higher fidelity at proportionally higher cost.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature for token generation. 0.0 is greedy; higher values increase diversity at the cost of fidelity.
